name: Catch a Brainrot Container
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Brainrot Containers!

👍 Like the game and join our group!

How to Play: 
📦 Open containers 
🧠 Collect Brainrots 
🤝 Cooperate to get better Mutated Containers 
💸 Generate money 
🐦‍🔥 Rebirth 
🍬 Buy better Brainrots

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players
